sla_terms_summary: Windward requests: uptime 99.99% for production endpoints (monthly), credit schedule tiered: critical outage (>99.5% downtime) = 25% monthly credit; major (<99.9%) = 10%; minor (<99.99%) = 2%. Maintenance window: max 4 hours/month; scheduled maintenance to have 14-day notice; emergency windows allowed but must be pre-approved and limited. Support: P1 response 30 min initial, P1 escalation timeline 2 hours for on-call engineer, P2 response 4 hours, 24/7 phone escalation for enterprise tier. Throughput guarantees: reserved pool sized to sustain baseline 10k rps with 3x burst capacity for 12 contiguous months; latency targets: chat p95 <=120ms, rerank p95 <=30ms. Fallback policy: automatic route to compatible quantized variant within same capacity tier; can opt-in for cross-region failover with higher cost.
